paragraphs.text: Dakmor is a swamp on the Dominarian island of Caliman , where a ruined Thran city lay hidden.
Dakmor was the home of the swamp queen Tojira and her nightstalker minions. The swamp is riddled with ghouls , bats and scorpions .
Though Dakmor lay in ruin for most of its history, it would eventually become a home base for scavengers in the wake of the Time Spiral crisis.
